name: Leo Cavagnis
source:
"I think there are still a lot of unstable things, but I will do my best!" 

A member of the Falzone Family.
He's ordered to look after and protect the protagonist.
Contrary to his appearance he is a serious hard-worker, but he is a bit soft and sometimes goes against the orders of his superiors.
